messages.subject: using pseudoPalette() with setColorMaps
parts:
I'm trying to generate array images using weights. The images I have
look very similar to each other, and I suspect it's because the
weights are between 0 and 1 and the color maps are not
differentiating the low and high weights very well. Would it be
possible to use pseudoPalette() with setColorMaps() instead of a fixed
palette?

victoria

messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: using pseudoPalette() with setColorMaps
parts:
You can use any function that takes an integer as its first argument
and returns equal number of colors (by default 256 colors are asked
for). The returned vector of colors will be the color ramp in the
images.

/HB
